limitations: Internal engineering review, not independent expert certification.
Capacities and rate constants are chosen teaching examples, not measured universal material properties.
Water density is approximated as 1 g/mL.
No swelling, dissolution, evaporation, loose surface-droplet, buoyancy or water-displacement solver.
Sample movement, draining markers and apparatus geometry are schematic; guide time is staged.
